228	**Env var (new):** `IMPERSONATION_COOKIE_SECRET` — 32+ random bytes base64. Add to `.env.local` + Supabase Edge secrets doc + Railway. If missing at runtime, action throws `CONFIG_ERROR` (fail loud). Do NOT reuse `SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET` (different rotation lifecycle).

53	  v_used  INTEGER;
54	  v_limit INTEGER;
55	BEGIN
56	  SELECT scans_used, scan_limit
57	    INTO v_used, v_limit
58	    FROM public.profiles

63	    RETURN FALSE;

66	  IF v_used >= v_limit THEN

-- ── Migration 015: Admin Support Ops ──────────────────────────
-- Rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.admin_impersonation_sessions;
--           DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.admin_error_log;
--           DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.is_super_admin();
--           DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.get_user_activity(UUID, INT);
--           DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_scans_status_created;
-- Adds:     admin_error_log, admin_impersonation_sessions
--           is_super_admin() helper, get_user_activity() RPC
--           Composite index scans(status, created_at DESC)
-- Safe to run on prod (<30s, no backfill, no table rewrite, no locks on hot tables)

BEGIN;

-- ── is_super_admin() helper (STABLE, SECURITY DEFINER) ────────
-- Reuses profiles.role column added in 004_admin_rbac.sql.
-- is_admin() already exists from 004 — do not redefine.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_admin()
RETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'super_admin'
  );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE;

-- ── admin_error_log ───────────────────────────────────────────
-- Immutable audit-style table: no updated_at, no handle_updated_at trigger.
-- Only resolved_at is stamped once on resolution.
-- INSERT restricted to service_role (no INSERT policy = RLS denies all non-service inserts).
-- PII classification: user_id PII:L2, ip_address PII:L3, route PII:L2, url PII:L2.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.admin_error_log (
  id              UUID        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  occurred_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  severity        TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'error'
                    CHECK (severity IN ('fatal', 'error', 'warning', 'info')),
  message         TEXT        NOT NULL,
  stack           TEXT,
  source          TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'server'
                    CHECK (source IN ('server', 'client', 'edge', 'cron')),
  url             TEXT,
  user_id         UUID        REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  route           TEXT,
  metadata        JSONB       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  resolved        BOOLEAN     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  resolved_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,
  resolved_by     UUID        REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  resolution_note TEXT
);

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.admin_error_log.user_id IS 'PII:L2 — associated user, may be null for anonymous errors';
COMMENT ON COLUMN public.admin_error_log.url IS 'PII:L2 — page URL at error time';
COMMENT ON COLUMN public.admin_error_log.route IS 'PII:L2 — Next.js route path';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_error_log_occurred
  ON public.admin_error_log (occurred_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_error_log_sev_occurred
  ON public.admin_error_log (severity, occurred_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_error_log_res_occurred
  ON public.admin_error_log (resolved, occurred_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_error_log_user
  ON public.admin_error_log (user_id);

ALTER TABLE public.admin_error_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "error_log_admin_read" ON public.admin_error_log;
CREATE POLICY "error_log_admin_read"
  ON public.admin_error_log FOR SELECT
  USING (public.is_admin());

-- No INSERT policy → only service_role can insert (bypasses RLS)
-- UPDATE restricted to super_admin only (for resolving errors)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "error_log_super_admin_update" ON public.admin_error_log;
CREATE POLICY "error_log_super_admin_update"
  ON public.admin_error_log FOR UPDATE
  USING (public.is_super_admin())
  WITH CHECK (public.is_super_admin());

-- ── admin_impersonation_sessions ──────────────────────────────
-- Audit-retention table: ON DELETE SET NULL intentionally NOT used here
-- because the spec uses ON DELETE CASCADE for admin_user_id / target_user_id
-- to allow full cleanup if a test user is hard-deleted.
-- Note: spec explicitly states CASCADE for this table (unlike admin_error_log
-- which uses SET NULL for audit retention).
-- INSERT + UPDATE → service_role only (no policy = RLS denies non-service).
-- PII classification: ip_address PII:L3, user_agent PII:L2.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.admin_impersonation_sessions (
  id              UUID        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  admin_user_id   UUID        NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  target_user_id  UUID        NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  started_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  expires_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  ended_at        TIMESTAMPTZ,
  reason          TEXT,
  ip_address      TEXT,
  user_agent      TEXT
);

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.admin_impersonation_sessions.ip_address IS 'PII:L3 — admin IP at session start, confidential';
COMMENT ON COLUMN public.admin_impersonation_sessions.user_agent IS 'PII:L2 — admin browser/client user-agent';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_impersonation_admin_started
  ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions (admin_user_id, started_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_impersonation_target_started
  ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions (target_user_id, started_at DESC);

-- Partial index: only active (non-ended) sessions, used for expiry checks
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_impersonation_active_expires
  ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions (expires_at)
  WHERE ended_at IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.admin_impersonation_sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Admin can only read their own sessions
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "impersonation_admin_read_own" ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions;
CREATE POLICY "impersonation_admin_read_own"
  ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions FOR SELECT
  USING (public.is_admin() AND admin_user_id = auth.uid());

-- super_admin can read all sessions (audit oversight)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "impersonation_super_admin_read_all" ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions;
CREATE POLICY "impersonation_super_admin_read_all"
  ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions FOR SELECT
  USING (public.is_super_admin());

-- ── Additive indexes for queue + activity lookups ─────────────
-- Composite index enables fast "stuck/failed scans" queue page queries:
--   SELECT * FROM scans WHERE status = 'analyzing' ORDER BY created_at DESC
-- The existing idx_scans_status (single-col) does not cover ORDER BY created_at.
-- The existing idx_scans_created_at (single-col) exists in 001 — this composite
-- supersedes for the specific (status, created_at DESC) access pattern.

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_scans_status_created
  ON public.scans (status, created_at DESC);

-- Decision: no new index on audit_logs needed.
-- Existing idx_audit_logs_target (target_type, target_id) in 004 adequately
-- covers activity timeline lookups: WHERE target_type='user' AND target_id=<uuid>.

-- ── get_user_activity() RPC ───────────────────────────────────
-- Admin-only. SECURITY DEFINER so it can query across RLS boundaries.
-- Top-level is_admin() guard ensures anon / plain users get 'forbidden' error.
-- Returns a merged, time-descending activity timeline for a given user across:
--   scans, audit_logs (admin actions on user), support_requests, impersonation sessions.
-- Koda consumers: hooks/admin/use-user-activity.ts via supabase.rpc('get_user_activity', ...)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_activity(uid UUID, lim INT DEFAULT 50)
RETURNS TABLE(kind TEXT, at TIMESTAMPTZ, summary TEXT, metadata JSONB) AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
    (
      SELECT
        'scan'::text                                                     AS kind,
        s.created_at                                                     AS at,
        COALESCE(s.page_title, s.url)                                    AS summary,
        jsonb_build_object('scan_id', s.id, 'status', s.status)          AS metadata
      FROM public.scans s
      WHERE s.user_id = uid
    )
    UNION ALL
    (
      SELECT
        'audit'::text                                                    AS kind,
        al.created_at                                                    AS at,
        al.action                                                        AS summary,
        al.metadata                                                      AS metadata
      FROM public.audit_logs al
      WHERE al.target_type = 'user'
        AND al.target_id = uid::text
    )
    UNION ALL
    (
      SELECT
        'support'::text                                                  AS kind,
        sr.created_at                                                    AS at,
        sr.subject                                                       AS summary,
        jsonb_build_object('id', sr.id, 'status', sr.status)             AS metadata
      FROM public.support_requests sr
      WHERE sr.user_id = uid
    )
    UNION ALL
    (
      SELECT
        'impersonation'::text                                            AS kind,
        ais.started_at                                                   AS at,
        'Admin impersonation'::text                                      AS summary,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'admin_id', ais.admin_user_id,
          'ended_at', ais.ended_at
        )                                                                AS metadata
      FROM public.admin_impersonation_sessions ais
      WHERE ais.target_user_id = uid
    )
  ORDER BY 2 DESC
  LIMIT lim;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE;

COMMIT;
